propositions: The parent-first cascade logic is implemented twice in separate modules (claim.py and transition.py) with identical ghost/init preconditions but different decision tables

A shared lifecycle_cascade.py module should extract the walk algorithm (ancestor recursion, cycle guard, TOCTOU re-check, error rewrap) while keeping _CASCADING_EDGES and decision logic in transition.py
The cascade fires on three edges (open→in_progress, closed→open, closed→in_progress) and * → closed must not cascade
All three cascading edges must be exercised by parametrised tests driven from the live _CASCADING_EDGES table for both claim and transition surfaces
The inbound reconcile cascade and apply_inbound_events._cascade_inbound_status_parents deliberately stay separate because they require topmost-first ordering and their own write primitives
